displayName: Radar - operational suspension or dependency failure

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="radar-publico-bot" AND (jsonPayload.event="dependency_failure" OR jsonPayload.event="limit_global" OR jsonPayload.event="limit_external" OR jsonPayload.event="limit_suspended")

documentation.content: Check Radar counters and costs. Suspend only radar_publico_ops/control or QUERIES_ENABLED. Never disable shared project billing or change dodfpmdfbot service.
